description: One Predict.fun market's on-chain fills with the wallet behind each, newest first: ts (epoch ms), tx_hash, wallet, counterparty, role (maker/taker), side (BUY/SELL of token_id), outcome, size (shares), price (0-1), usd, fee. Returns {trades, next_cursor}. One row is one ORDER's fill, not one match: a match is a `maker` row per resting order hit plus one `taker` row for the order that took them (whose amounts are theirs added up), so add `usd` over ONE role, never both.

cursor.description: A previous page's `next_cursor`, unchanged, to read the next page.

market_id.description: The Predict.fun market id (`market_id` from predictfun_markets). Required.
